name: letter

source.prompt: One cream-white premium commercial correspondence card, flat landscape rectangle, seen almost front-on. A few thin tone-on-tone embossed horizontal rules at the top-left, otherwise intentionally blank. Real deckled paper fibers, clean crisp corners, strong subtle bevel at lower edge. No graphics, words, stamps, envelope or other objects.

method: Use aligned region mask and original neutral luminance. Model used neutral top-left light. Diffuse = min(1,1.2*luma^0.74), specular shoulder above .80, preserve original alpha and unmasked pixels. Region construction is recorded in palette.ts.
